name: pano-whiteboard
description: Pano - real-time collaborative whiteboard (React + Yjs CRDT + WebSocket)
author: Nurullah Mencik

scripts.dev: npm run dev -w server & npm run dev -w web

scripts.test: npm run test -w web && npm run test -w server
